  cc.category_name AS "内容分类",
  COUNT(vi.interaction_id) AS "互动数"
FROM video_interactions vi
JOIN contents c ON vi.content_id = c.content_id
JOIN content_categories cc ON c.category_id = cc.category_id
WHERE vi.interaction_type = 'share'
GROUP BY cc.category_name
ORDER BY "互动数" DESC, cc.category_name ASC
cases.gold_sql: SELECT cat.category_name,COUNT(i.interaction_id) interactions FROM video_interactions i JOIN contents c ON i.content_id=c.content_id JOIN content_categories cat ON c.category_id=cat.category_id WHERE i.interaction_type='share' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1

  cc.category_name AS content_category,
  COUNT(c.content_id) AS content_count,
  AVG(c.duration_seconds) AS avg_video_duration
FROM contents c

WHERE cc.category_name = '搞笑'

ORDER BY cc.category_name
